scenes.title: Scene 1: The Career Challenge
scenes.voiceover: You have the experience. You have the skills. Now it's time to take your career to the next level.

scenes.title: Scene 2: Introducing NHIT Durgapur
scenes.voiceover: Introducing The New Horizons Institute of Technology, Durgapur. Your opportunity to advance through technical education.

scenes.title: Scene 3: Choose Your Engineering Branch
scenes.voiceover: Choose your next step. Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Two opportunities to build your technical future.

scenes.title: Scene 4: Candidate Eligibility
scenes.voiceover: If you have the required academic qualification and at least one year of regular work experience, this opportunity could be for you.

scenes.title: Scene 5: Affiliation and Approved Intake
scenes.voiceover: With 30 approved seats each in Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, take your next step towards professional growth.

scenes.title: Scene 6: Final Brand Reveal & CTA
scenes.voiceover: The New Horizons Institute of Technology, Durgapur. Shape your engineering career today. Enquire now.
